field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_FIELD_PROJECT_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id AS value,name AS text FROM #__joomleague_project WHERE published=1 ORDER BY name

field.name: stage_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_PROGRESSION_STAGE_LABEL
field.query: SELECT s.id AS value,CONCAT(p.name,' - ',s.name) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project_stage s INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project p ON p.id=s.project_id WHERE s.published=1 AND p.published=1 ORDER BY p.name,s.sequence_number
